title: Reasons Given by Applicants for Rental Flats
what_it_is: Reasons Given by Applicants for Rental Flats

sections.label: Rental flat applications and take-up
sections.summary: In the last 10 years, an average of 3,000 households a year succeeded in rental flat applications, and 2,600 a year moved in.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In the last 10 years, an average of 3,000 households a year were successful in their applications for rental flats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Of these, an average of 2,600 households a year decided to move into HDB rental flats, with the remainder cancelling their rental request, for example, because they have found alternative housing options.

sections.label: Rental flat returns and stock
sections.summary: About 1,600 households returned rental flats and now own flats; of about a million HDB flats, about 56,000 are rental.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Of these households, about 1,600 have returned their rental flats to HDB and now have their own home ownership flats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are about a million HDB flats, of which about 56,000 are rental flats, comprising a mix of 1- and 2-room apartments.
